content.summary: Engineer who takes systems from architecture to production — applied AI, backend services and dual-cloud infrastructure. Owns the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for five platforms now in government production — a multilingual assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in, and a ~60,000-LOC drafting platform built solo and piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session.

experience.employer: EY (deployed to National e-Governance Division, MeitY)
experience.context: Lead a team of 4 interns and 1 analyst. AI, backend and platform engineering for Government of India digital services — Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Sports Authority of India, and Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Architected a citizen-facing multilingual RAG assistant — 12 languages via Bhashini — with hybrid retrieval fusing pgvector ANN over chunks and 86,000 generated questions with pg_trgm lexical search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion; judged correctness 3.9 / 4 across a 213-case eval bank.

Built the async FastAPI service and worker behind it: Service Bus queue, Redis pub/sub token relay and SSE streaming, Redis in OSS cluster mode with a hash-tagged keyspace, two-layer caching and 14 runtime feature flags; cut run-rate ~60% (₹9.4L → ₹3.5L/month), 532 offline tests.

Added a Hindi/English voice channel over the same assistant (built, in UAT) — Pipecat, turn gate and echo guard, provider fail-fast, whole-buffer streaming redaction; the gateway owns audio and the bot owns answers, so the channels cannot drift. Time-to-first-token 12.6s → 9.1s; 40 gateway tests.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AWS Bedrock platform piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session — a 10-stage pipeline with semantic cache, LLM planner, answer-of-record reuse, reranking and recency blending with per-claim volatility half-lives, emitting per-sentence citations.

95 REST endpoints, 34 Postgres tables, 33 Alembic migrations; tuned concurrency for high fan-out and hardened LLM-authored SQL with sqlglot AST validation. 312 tests green, SAST at zero critical findings.

blocks.title: PMIS — AI scoping, Prime Minister Internship Scheme · Ministry of Corporate Affairs

bullets.text: Authored the 12,000-word AI Scope Document and 14-page Feasibility Assessment — 19 use cases consolidated into 8 features on 6 shared building blocks across a 144 person-month programme, phased behind five data gates.

experience.context: Oracle Cloud Partner — 20+ enterprise clients including Aditya Birla Group, Adani, and Acko.

bullets.text: Architected a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AWS EC2 + Nginx, cutting deploy time 80% (15 min to under 3) with zero-downtime rolling releases, saving ~2 hrs of manual effort per cycle.

Engineered a real-time inventory backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) automating 3 reconciliation workflows, eliminating ~4 hrs/day of ops overhead, and consolidating 15+ scattered permission checks into one JWT RBAC middleware layer.

experience.context: Ed-tech platform delivering courses in web development, ML, and embedded systems to students across India.

bullets.text: Reduced frontend render latency by ~28% on a live multi-user ML platform (React DevTools Profiler) via React.memo and lazy loading — zero backend changes, zero regressions.
Built vendor-agnostic normalisation adapters over third-party ML APIs, fully decoupling business logic from vendor schemas and making future API swaps non-breaking.
